board.verification_source: user statement 2026-11-19; physical photo/marking check still recommended
board.clone_note: If the unit is a clone/compatible board, record Q08=B and do not claim official Espressif origin.
notes: v1.0 onboard RGB = GPIO48; v1.1 = GPIO38. This build locks GPIO48.
v1.0 and v1.1 use 2 x 1x22 headers, 2.54 mm pitch, 22.86 mm row spacing; socket footprint unchanged.
No external I2C, OLED, RTC, or RGB connector in REV_D.
Avoid GPIO26-37 (flash/PSRAM); N16R8 uses octal PSRAM.
External pulldown on relay control is mandatory for boot-safe OFF.

limitations: Board revision is user-confirmed, not measured; GPIO assignments remain static design data.
No physical waveform, boot, or onboard-RGB test was performed.
Firmware header crosscheck is static; it does not prove electrical behavior.
